plainText:
Taku Yashiro (Japanese: 八代拓 Yashiro Taku) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Yashiro was born on January 6, 1993, and is affiliated with VIMS talent agency. Yashiro became a voice actor in 2013 and first worked on Pokémon, voicing Gordie in . Yashiro joined , voicing Friede.
